signal: Ambient.ai doubled new ARR in FY26 and unveiled Pulsar, its reasoning vision-language model, after a $74M Series B and a strategic investment from Allegion.

email.body1:
Jared, saw Ambient doubled new ARR in FY26 and unveiled Pulsar for agentic physical security.

Growth at that pace usually means more strategic accounts in play than the team can cover before the motion settles, and that is where enterprise deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ambient off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jared, quick follow-up for Ambient.

After doubling ARR, the strategic-accounts target probably grew faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ambient needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jared, last bit of proof for Ambient.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ambient's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jared, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic-account pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know an ARR-doubling year keeps a calendar full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Ambient's strategic motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
